'''Olkav''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] serving the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Gehn's Overlook]] outpost on [[Voss]], looking to synthesize a vaccine against the corruption of the [[Nightmare Lands]]. Using a deranged Imperial soldier [[Lem]] as his test subject, Olkav asked an Imperial retrieve a missing component for the vaccine - [[Sap/Legends|sap]] from a specific tree in the Nightmare Lands.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Olkav appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Voss, who begins the mission "Tapping Corruption."
